title: UN condemns reported Haitian village massacre by armed gangs
summary: Fishing village of Labodrie reportedly set on fire after killing of a gang leader in sign of rising violence outside capital The UN secretary-general has condemned the reported killing of at least 40 people during an attack by armed gangs in a fishing village north of Haiti’s capital. Media in Haiti widely reported that the attack took place on Thursday night in Labodrie. It is another sign of escalating gang violence that has spread outside the capital. Continue reading...
